experiments.why: One carrier with a figure and no missing months: the rewritten intro lines, and a why line without 'across' or the final period.
One month without an invoice, where 'is left out, having no invoice yet' becomes 'not counted, no invoice yet'.
Two missing months and a thousands-separated count, where the old plural 'are left out' wording is replaced.
Invoices in mixed currencies, whose explanation sentence was rewritten and lost its 'enter them in one currency' advice.
Parcels but no invoice yet, whose message changes to 'Enter an invoice below to see the cost.'
No parcels in the period, where the why line stays the same and only the intro paragraphs change.
Two carriers with their month rows, checking each Carrier still gets only its own months under the reworded section.
No carriers, which must still render nothing in both versions.
